title: First row recovered from an encoded matrix
statement: For a row $r$ of natural numbers and a list $R$ of such rows, the total first projection of the encoding of the matrix whose first row is $r$ and whose remaining rows are $R$ equals the encoding of $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a list of natural numbers
$R$ is a list of lists of natural numbers
